final_exception_rules: Success response validation inside callback: false throws RESPONSE_INVARIANT_FAILED500 before COMMIT; validator ApiFault retains code/status and unknown error is INTERNAL_ERROR500. Both remain exceptions.
Only returned clean denial/wait outcomes proceed to transaction resolution then HTTP409. HTTP409 from a thrown ApiFault is not evidence of commit.
Rollback ACK loss is ledger/model knowledge only; driver original error mapping is preserved, no confirmed rollback or committed S0 guarantee and no commit_unknown reclassification.
Both committed/uncommitted COMMIT-ACK loss use StorageUnavailable(commit_unknown):503, no success/retry/rollback claim.
Post-commit Response failure does not undo committed command.
Schema-valid active is not prefiltered: new visible active command422, same-key changed status after removed receipt409.

instrumentation.entries: Direct domain/guard/effect debugger entry breakpoints; not async V8 entry counts.
instrumentation.writes: Reachable Proxy set/define/delete attempts, including failing attempts; raw aliases are outside exhaustive observation. Four native/plain controls mark writes NOT_INSTRUMENTED.
instrumentation.clone: Only registered observer proxies unwrap before real native structuredClone; unknown Proxy/function negative controls and original native/plain controls retained.
instrumentation.retry: Observed one verifier, transaction, direct domain and COMMIT attempt in ACK-loss cases; retries field is an annotation rather than a measured retry hook.
instrumentation.uncertainty: Rollback-ACK-loss records omit committed and expected_committed fields. model_only_committed_snapshot is explicitly not a handler or durability guarantee.
instrumentation.transport: In-process Fetch Request/Response; existing affected regression listeners use localhost and statement doubles. No new production/listener activation.
